technical.title: Voxel51 3.0 launches as a unified multimodal data platform for physical AI.
technical.summary: Voxel51 3.0 combines search, curation, annotation, and evaluation of multimodal sensor data into a single platform for physical AI teams, featuring the Voxel51 Agent with 45+ MCP tools and dataset versioning.
technical.why: It streamlines multimodal data management specifically for physical AI and computer vision workflows.

technical.title: Kyutai REKI is a 2.4B vision-language-action model for robot manipulation.
technical.summary: Kyutai, along with Inria and École des Ponts, released REKI, a 2.4B vision-language-action model for robot manipulation trained entirely on public data with efficient memory of its recent past.
technical.why: It delivers strong out-of-distribution performance for robotics and autonomous driving manipulation tasks at a smaller scale.

technical.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL powers specialized agents with multimodal reasoning.
technical.summary: Always-on agents handle longer workflows that involve reading documents and checking information across multiple sources using specialized multimodal reasoning models.
technical.why: It enhances multimodal agent architectures for complex enterprise tasks.

technical.title: Meta launches Muse Spark Open, an 816B MoE coding model on NVIDIA hardware.
technical.summary: Meta introduces Muse Spark Open, a coding-optimized 816B mixture-of-experts model featuring 42B active parameters and a 1M token context window, optimized for NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 infrastructure.
technical.why: It provides a massive open-weight baseline for scaling advanced agentic coding workflows.

technical.title: Researchers introduce semCER, a severity-weighted character error rate metric for OCR and VLMs.
technical.summary: Researchers introduce semCER, a metric for OCR and vision-language models that uses an LLM judge to assign a severity score to grapheme edits instead of treating all typos equally. It aligns with human ratings better than standard CER.
technical.why: It provides a better evaluation metric for computer vision models dealing with text recognition.

technical.title: MINE-SAMPLE-RENDER approach improves test-time diversity alignment for generative models.
technical.summary: The MINE-SAMPLE-RENDER test-time approach improves diversity in generative models by mining a categorical schema from real artifact corpora, sampling attribute configurations, and using the generative model as a conditional renderer.
technical.why: It offers a new technique to enhance output diversity in generative computer vision and text-to-image models.

technical.title: New automated weak-to-strong hardening approach prevents reward hacking in agent environments.
technical.summary: A new automated approach uses scaled compute to harden agent environment verifiers, preventing future stronger models from exploiting rewards and hacking the system without completing tasks.
technical.why: It secures evaluation and training loops for advanced autonomous agent environments.

technical.title: Perplexity open-sources SPACE, a Firecracker microVM sandbox for AI agents.
technical.summary: Perplexity open-sourced SPACE under Apache 2.0, providing a production-tested sandbox platform where each AI agent task runs in its own Firecracker microVM with externally controlled credentials and outbound traffic.
technical.why: It gives engineering teams a robust isolation environment for deploying coding and browsing agents securely.

technical.title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore introduces a nine-stage evaluation framework for autonomous agents.
technical.summary: A nine-stage evaluation framework built on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore catches silent quality regressions across the full agent lifecycle, preventing answer quality erosion while latency remains flat.
technical.why: It provides production readiness tracking for teams deploying autonomous AI agents.

technical.title: Reflection AI's Beam open-weight model enables agentic coding on AWS infrastructure.
technical.summary: Reflection AI's Beam is an open-weight model for agentic coding and long-horizon tasks, deployable on AWS via Amazon SageMaker JumpStart or HyperPod Inference with SGLang and vLLM.
technical.why: It offers practical deployment pathways for running large-scale agentic coding models on distributed GPU clusters.

business.title: Nvidia veteran calls robotics current state a Lego era
business.summary: Former Nvidia robotics marketing lead Amulya Vishwanath states robotics is in a Lego era where basic building blocks like actuators, robotic hands, software, and safety standards are still being rebuilt.
business.why: It offers industry perspective on the hardware and software hurdles facing physical AI and robotics.

business.title: Asian startup funding reached $38.5 billion in Q3, driven by AI
business.summary: Investors put $38.5 billion into reported seed through growth-stage financings for Asian startups in Q3, per Crunchbase data, with a majority going to AI-focused companies.
business.why: It highlights regional investment velocity and the dominance of AI in venture capital.

business.title: Startup investors scale back on giant AI funding rounds
business.summary: Startup investors scaled back on giant rounds this past week, with just two startup financings reaching the multiple hundreds of millions.
business.why: It indicates a potential cooling or stabilization in massive capital deployments for AI startups.

business.title: AI stocks plunge. Inflation heats up. Where we're still finding opportunities
business.summary: The sinking AI trade rattled last week's market. But solid bank earnings and a rotation beyond tech gave us reasons for optimism.

business.title: AWS, Anthropic race to deploy army of specialized engineers key to proving AI spending will pay off
business.summary: AWS, Anthropic, OpenAI and Google are racing to build forward deployed engineering teams as companies seek returns on their AI investments.

business.title: Wall Street's latest AI spook, Netflix layoffs, 'good debt' and more in Morning Squawk
business.summary: Here are five key things investors need to know to start the trading day.

business.title: Elorian’s first AI model wants to reason with images, not just about them
business.summary: According to Elorian's evaluations, Glimpse outperforms even GPT-6 Astra on scientific chart reasoning and short-form video captioning, with competitive results on other visual reasoning tasks.

business.title: Mark Wahlberg on using AI in film ‘the right way’ and being open to an AI clone carrying on his legacy
business.summary: Actor and angel investor Mark Wahlberg says he's OK with using AI in filmmaking, provided it's used "to enhance what you're doing."

business.title: Meta removes language allowing scraping of news sites for AI
business.summary: Meta updated its terms to remove language that suggested it could scrape content from sites, including news sites, to train its AI following backlash.
business.why: It impacts data acquisition strategies and legal boundaries for major AI developers.

business.title: Websites are closing their doors to AI agents
business.summary: Autonomous agents are the hottest thing in AI. OpenAI, Meta, Google, Instinct, and others promise their agents can scour the internet on your behalf, doing anything from booking a dinner reservation and cleaning out your

models.title: MiniCPM-V 4.7 introduces the first MoE model in the series with on-device inference
models.summary: MiniCPM-V 4.7 features a 35B-A3B variant, making it the first Mixture-of-Experts model in the series, combining single-image, multi-image, and video capabilities with efficient on-device scheduling.
models.why: Delivers powerful multi-image and video understanding capabilities directly on edge hardware.

models.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 update improves reasoning, coding, visual benchmarks, and execution speed
models.summary: This minor update delivers substantial improvements across reasoning, coding, agentic tasks, and visual benchmarks while reducing task execution time and output length to lower costs.
models.why: Provides faster and cheaper execution for multi-modal and agentic workflows.

models.title: LiquidAI releases LFM2.5-24B-A2B reasoning model for fast private on-device agents
models.summary: LFM2.5-24B-A2B is a 24B-parameter reasoning model with only 2B active parameters, built for fast, private on-device agentic and tool-use tasks.
models.why: Enables efficient, low-latency reasoning on edge devices for autonomous agents.

models.title: Baidu introduces Unlimited OCR for one-shot long-horizon parsing tasks
models.summary: Unlimited OCR enables one-shot long-horizon parsing and now supports training with ms-swift, Baidu Cloud, and vLLM inference.
models.why: Improves long-horizon document parsing and OCR pipelines for multi-modal applications.

models.title: Google DeepMind releases EmbeddingGemma 2, a multimodal embedding model for consumer hardware
models.summary: EmbeddingGemma 2 maps text, code, images, video, and audio into a unified 768-dimensional vector space using 740M total parameters, designed for low-latency on-device applications.

models.title: Qwen-Image-2.1 Uncensored Quantized formats released for local image generation
models.summary: Provides GGUF, Safetensors, and MLX quantized formats of Qwen-Image-2.1 for local image generation using ComfyUI with companion text encoders and VAEs.
models.why: Facilitates local, customized image generation workflows for computer vision engineers.
